title: Existence of bases implies the axiom of choice, a foundation-free proof
summary: We prove that, in Zermelo--Fraenkel set theory with the axiom of Foundation removed, the statement that every vector space has a basis implies the Axiom of Choice ($\mathsf{AC}$), concluding that the classical equivalence between $\mathsf{AC}$ and the existence of bases does not require regularity. This result extends to set theory with atoms.
